verdict.reason: Verified independently: `forwardUpstreamError` is called at packages/cli/src/commands/cells.ts:147 (the `sheets cells batch` action registered at cells.ts:103) and packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-import.ts:91, but neither is driven through a non-ok upstream response by any test. The end-to-end CASES table in upstream-error.test.ts:211-245 (comment: "Every other command that talks to the backend") covers sheets cells get/set/delete, sheets tabs list/create/rename and sheets export, and the second CASES table at upstream-error.test.ts:356-541 covers docs/notes/slides import plus files upload/download — neither includes `sheets cells batch` or `sheets import`. Repo-wide grep for `batchCells` yields only three hits, all in src/ (http-client.ts:356, cells.ts:142, sheets-import.ts:90) and zero in tests; repo-wide grep for argv invocations `'sheets', 'cells'` / `'sheets', 'import'` yields only output.test.ts:285/317 and upstream-error.test.ts:231-233. The single `sheets cells batch` test (output.test.ts:315-326) asserts `fetchMock` was NOT called and code `'ERROR'`, i.e. a pre-request JSON parse failure, so it cannot fail if the `!res.ok` branch regresses. `sheets import` is never invoked by any test (files-upload.test.ts:61,176 only assert a hint string mentioning "sheets import"; namespaces.test.ts:68 only asserts the subcommand is registered). Glob confirms packages/cli/test is the only CLI test dir and no e2e script exercises these paths. Both sites carry extra pre-request logic (stdin/--data parse, CSV/JSON parse, dry-run, imported-count merge), so they are not covered by symmetry with the tested one-liners. Missing test for a changed behavior — major under this lens.
